Bill.BriefDescription: Ensuring minimum proper veterinarian care standards for certain dogs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to ensuring the minimum proper veterinarian carestandard for young dogs; adding new sections to chapter 16.08 RCW;creating a new section; prescribing penalties; and providing aneffective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department of agriculture shalladopt and maintain rules identifying the minimum proper veterinariancare standard for a dog under twelve months of age necessary tomaximize the health of a dog under twelve months of age or minimize thespread of diseases. (2) Rules adopted under this section must identify: (a) The proper vaccinations that a dog under twelve months of ageshould receive; (b) The approved process and schedule for treating a dog undertwelve months of age for worms and other parasites; and (c) A timeline for separating a dog under twelve months of age fromits mother or litter.

(1) Except as otherwise provided in thischapter, any person either selling a dog under twelve months of age inthe state of Washington or selling a dog under twelve months of agethat is destined for delivery into the state of Washington must firstfully comply with the minimum proper veterinarian care standard for adog under twelve months of age developed by the department ofagriculture under section 1 of this act. (2) This section applies to the person conducting the initial saleof an individual dog under twelve months of age. However, subsequentsellers of the individual dog under twelve months of age must provideinformation as to whom provided the minimum proper veterinarian care.

Section 2 of this act does not apply to: (1) A dog with documentation that readily indicates that the dog isover twelve months of age at the time of sale; (2) A dog species other than the common domesticated dog (Canisfamiliaris); (3) A dog that is not sold for money or exchanged for a good orservice; or (4) A dog sold in accordance with section 4 of this act.

(1) The initial buyer of an individual dogunder twelve months of age may agree with the seller to waive therequirements of section 2 of this act. However, to avoid liabilityunder this chapter, the seller must be able to demonstrate that thebuyer signed a document outlining: (a) The responsibilities of the seller that are being waived; (b) The minimum proper veterinarian care standards that have notbeen adequately provided to the dog; and (c) The buyer's responsibilities should the dog be resold. (2) A buyer of a dog waiving the responsibilities of a seller underthis section that wishes to resell the dog must provide documentationto a prospective subsequent buyer as to which responsibilities werewaived.

A violation of section 2 of this act is aclass 1 civil infraction under chapter 7.80 RCW and may be enforced by: HB 2202 p. 2 (1) Any general authority Washington peace officer, as defined inRCW 10.93.020; or (2) Representatives of the department of agriculture, authorized bythe director of the department of agriculture to enforce section 2 ofthis act.

(1) The department of agriculture shallprovide information on their official internet web site relating to therequirements of section 2 of this act, including a mechanism for thereporting of sellers suspected of violating section 2 of this act. (2) If the department of agriculture determines that any suspectedviolations of section 2 of this act reported to the department may belegitimate, it shall initiate an investigation of the report or providethe pertinent information to the appropriate local general authoritylaw enforcement agency.
Nothing in this chapter limits prosecutionfor the violation of any other criminal statute, enforcement of anyother law, or the liability of the seller in related civil proceedings.
Initial rulemaking under section 1 of thisact must be completed by January 1, 2010.
Sections 2 through 7 of this act take effectJanuary 1, 2010.

(1) Sections 1 through 8 of this act areeach added to chapter 16.08 RCW and codified with the subchapterheading of "minimum veterinarian care." (2) The code reviser is directed to add a subchapter heading tochapter 16.08 RCW entitled "dangerous dogs." RCW 16.08.010 through16.08.100 must be included in the subchapter entitled "dangerous dogs."
